import FS
import IO
import Path
import Proc
import Hash
import Digest
import Map
import List
import String

let walk! root rel =
  let dir = if rel == "" then Path.of_string root else Path.of_string "%{root}/%{rel}"
  List.flat_map (fn p ->
    let name = Path.to_string (Path.basename p)
    let r = if rel == "" then name else "%{rel}/%{name}"
    let full = Path.of_string "%{root}/%{r}"
    if FS.dir? full then walk! root r
    else if FS.file? full then [r]

  | [] ->
    IO.println_err "usage: prog DIR"
    Proc.exit 2

      IO.println_err "not a directory: %{root}"
      Proc.exit 1

        let h = Digest.hex (Hash.file! Digest.Sha256 (Path.of_string "%{root}/%{r}"))

main! ()
